## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: endorsements, renewal, license loss and the graduated license steps
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical guide page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The list of reasons a license can be suspended, revoked or denied runs across a page break; each fact block cites only the page that prints the reasons it names [A05] [A06].
The veteran designation lists many discharge form numbers; only the DD Form 214 example is restated, and the full form list stays on the page [A04].
The checklist page prints its own page marker inside the text; the credential terms and GDL step three rules were read from that page only where the step label and its conditions sat together [A08].
The renewal fee printed in reminder letters, office phone numbers and the donor, veteran and voter websites are service details that can change and are isolated as dynamic.
Statute citations in the optional-notation paragraphs were summarized, not copied.

corpus_stability.reason: The Missouri Driver Guide prints a single edition line on its front cover (Revised August 2026); its table-of-contents note says law and policy changes may make parts out of date and points to the website for the current version, with no sign in the selected pages of more than one rewrite per year.
